raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

`release-docker-amd-miles-rocm724-nightly.yml` builds and pushes `rocm/sgl-dev:miles-rocm724-mi35x` every day, but no nightly in this repo runs against it. #37495 moved the Miles nightly to ROCm 10 and deleted the 7.2 test workflow. Since #40387 (2026-09-24), this job has been publishing an image that nothing here tests.

## Modifications

Delete `release-docker-amd-miles-rocm724-nightly.yml`. The ROCm 10 build (`release-docker-amd-miles-rocm10-nightly.yml`, MI35X + MI30X) and both ROCm 10 Miles nightlies are unchanged. No other file in the repo references the removed workflow.

## Miles CI

Miles' own ROCm CI used the undated `miles-rocm724-mi35x` tag that this job overwrites. radixark/miles#4514 (merged) moved it to `miles-rocm10-mi35x`, so nothing reads the 7.2.4 tag now and this can merge.

Since #40387 (2026-09-24), this job has been publishing an image that nothing here tests.

## Modifications

Delete `release-docker-amd-miles-rocm724-nightly.yml`. The ROCm 10 build (`release-docker-amd-miles-rocm10-nightly.yml`, MI35X + MI30X) and both ROCm 10 Miles nightlies are unchanged. No other file in the repo references the removed workflow.

## Miles CI

Miles' own ROCm CI used the undated `miles-rocm724-mi35x` tag that this job overwrites. radixark/miles#4514 (merged) moved it to `miles-rocm10-mi35x`, so nothing reads the 7.2.4 tag now and this can merge.
detail.title: [CI] [AMD] miles: drop the ROCm 7.2.4 MI35X nightly image build

files.patch:
@@ -1,60 +0,0 @@
-name: Release Docker Images Nightly Miles ROCm7.2.4 (AMD)
-
-on:
-  workflow_dispatch:
-  schedule:
-    - cron: "0 12 * * *"
-
-concurrency:
-  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.number || github.sha }}
-  cancel-in-progress: true
-
-jobs:
-  publish:
-    if: github.repository == 'sgl-project/sglang'
-    runs-on: amd-docker-scale
-    environment: "prod"
-    permissions:
-      contents: read
-    strategy:
-      fail-fast: false
-      matrix:
-        variant:
-          - rocm724-mi35x
-    steps:
-      - name: Checkout miles repository
-        uses: actions/checkout@v4
-        with:
-          repository: radixark/miles
-          ref: main
-          fetch-depth: 0
-          persist-credentials: false
-
-      - name: Record miles commit
-        run: echo "Building from miles main @ $(git rev-parse HEAD)"
-
-      - name: Set date
-        run: echo "DATE=$(date +%Y%m%d)" >> $GITHUB_ENV
-
-      - name: Install docker/build.py dependencies
-        run: |
-          sudo apt-get update
-          sudo apt-get install -y python3-pip
-          python3 -m pip install --break-system-packages --quiet typer
-
-      - name: Build image via miles docker/build.py and tag with date
-        run: |
-          python3 docker/build.py --variant ${{ matrix.variant }} --image-tag custom --custom-tag miles
-          docker tag rocm/sgl-dev:miles-${{ matrix.variant }} rocm/sgl-dev:miles-${{ matrix.variant }}-${DATE}
-
-      - name: Login to Docker Hub (AMD)
-        uses: docker/login-action@v2
-        with:
-          username: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_AMD_USERNAME }}
-          password: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_AMD_TOKEN }}
-
-      - name: Push dated tag
-        run: docker push rocm/sgl-dev:miles-${{ matrix.variant }}-${DATE}
-
-      - name: Push the undated tag
-        run: docker push rocm/sgl-dev:miles-${{ matrix.variant }}
